items.definition:
an exact copy
Scientists successfully created a clone of the animal.

the process or state of excluding or being excluded
The exclusion of certain groups from the event caused controversy.

the action of setting something on fire or starting to burn
He turned the key in the ignition.

the extent or length of reaching out
The charity's outreach program helps many homeless people.

a disease prevalent over a whole country or the world
The world faced a severe pandemic last year.

a large predatory freshwater fish
He caught a large pike in the lake.

a soft, wet, shapeless mass of material
The oranges were squeezed into a thick pulp.

a sum of money demanded or paid for the release of a captive
The kidnappers demanded a large ransom for the safe return of the child.

a widely held but fixed and oversimplified image or idea of a particular type of person or thing
It's important to challenge harmful stereotypes about different cultures.

the number of people attending or taking part in an event
The turnout for the concert was much higher than expected.

the policy or action of using vigorous campaigning to bring about political or social change
Environmental activism has led to significant policy changes.

arrival; beginning
The advent of the internet changed everything.

a building or group of buildings used to house soldiers
The soldiers returned to the barracks after training.

an underground shelter
They took shelter in the bunker during the storm.

a public festival or celebration
They attended a charity gala last night.

friendly, helpful, or cooperative feelings or attitude
The company built up a lot of goodwill with its customers.

a set of straps and fittings by which a horse or other draft animal is fastened to a cart, plow, etc.
The horse wore a leather harness.

The rhythmic pulsation of the heart.
I could feel my own heartbeat in my ears.

Material used to prevent the passage of heat, sound, or electricity.
Good insulation keeps the house warm in winter.

A delay or slowing down.
There was a noticeable lag in the video stream.

The precise position or location of something.
We searched the entire locality for the missing dog.

Something used to entice or attract.
The promise of a bonus was a powerful lure for the employees.

A form of government with a monarch at the head.
The country has been a constitutional monarchy for centuries.

A division or separation.
They installed a glass partition to divide the office space.

The leading character or one of the major characters in a drama, movie, novel, or other fictional text.
The protagonist of the novel was a young detective.

a long, angry speech
He went on a long rant about the poor customer service.

an exact copy
The museum displayed a perfect replica of the ancient vase.

a person who saves someone or something from danger
He was hailed as the savior of the company.

a type of fungus used in baking and brewing
Yeast makes bread rise.

the process of taking something in
The plant's roots are responsible for water absorption.

a strong desire to achieve something
Her greatest aspiration is to become a doctor.

a person who murders an important person
The assassin was hired to eliminate the political leader.

a strong negative reaction
The new policy caused a huge backlash from the public.

security for a loan
He used his house as collateral for the bank loan.

a person or company to whom money is owed
The company is trying to repay its creditors.

a blend of two or more styles or categories
The band's new album is a crossover of rock and electronic music.

a difficult or critical situation; a sound
We're facing a financial crunch this month.

the state of relying on someone or something
Our dependence on fossil fuels is a major concern.

a ruler with total power
The country was ruled by a ruthless dictator for decades.

the action or state of paying no attention to something
He showed a complete disregard for the rules.

a person or company that supplies goods to stores or other businesses
We are looking for a new distributor for our products in Asia.

the state of being a mother; motherhood
She is currently on maternity leave.

the confidence, enthusiasm, and discipline of a person or group
The team's morale was low after the defeat.

the quality of being new, original, or unusual
The novelty of the new toy soon wore off.

hopefulness and confidence about the future
Her optimism helped us through difficult times.

a binary compound of oxygen with another element or group
Rust is a form of iron oxide.

a poor farmer of low social status
In medieval times, most people were peasants.

the fact of being widespread
The prevalence of obesity is a growing concern.

a person who watches at a show, game, or other event
The spectators cheered loudly for their team.

the activity of telling or writing stories
The art of storytelling is ancient and universal.

the quality of being stupid
His stupidity led to a series of unfortunate events.

a sloping position or movement
The table had a slight tilt to one side.

a piece of fine material worn by women to protect or conceal the face
The bride wore a beautiful white veil.

A blood vessel that carries blood away from the heart.
The surgeon repaired the damaged artery.

Alcoholic drink.
They went out to buy some booze for the party.

The quality of someone's character or ability; the internal diameter of a gun barrel.
The new employee showed a high caliber of work.

A thing that is granted, especially in response to demands; a reduction in price.
The company made a concession to the striking workers.

A low-ranking non-commissioned officer in the army.
Corporal Jones led the patrol.

The top of a hill or wave; a distinctive device or design.
They reached the crest of the hill.

The action of deceiving someone.
The magician's trick relied on clever deception.

A person from the Dominican Republic; a member of a Roman Catholic order of friars.
Many Dominicans live in New York City.

A fight between two people, often with weapons, to settle a point of honor.
The two knights fought a duel.

The process of freeing someone from an obligation or liability imposed on others.
He applied for an exemption from military service.

a small bomb thrown by hand or launched from a rifle
The soldier threw a smoke grenade to cover their advance.
